findings.evidence: OrthogonalSum.lean:220 `piGlueAlphabetCongr` and :225 `QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.pi`; Glued.lean:339 `gluedLatticeIsometry` requires `hφ : ∀ w, e.discriminantQuadraticIsometry … (glueWordIsometry … w) = glueWordIsometry … (φ w)`.

findings.issue: `rotation` is a one-row isometry where the roadmap target (componentwise isometry plus component permutation) has a general form built from existing pieces. summary: The glue isometry is built by hand for this one row: a private Klein-four triality `(a,b) ↦ (a+b,a)` with case-checked additivity and norm proofs, instead of the existing `D₄` glue-alphabet triality and the general permutation-plus-componentwise isometry combinators.
